text.p: - Today Russia's President Boris Yeltsin will try to crack the problem of delayed pension payments which is one of the country's most acute problems.
- According to Russia's Finance Ministry, customs union with Belarus has cost Russia's budget seven billion roubles.
- Both authorities and opposition claim victory in Russian regional elections.
- Russian Defence Minister Igor Rodionov's proposal to create a defence union of the Commonwealth of Independent States would hardly be welcomed by NATO.
- The end of the war in Chechnya is the most important event of 1996, says President Yeltsin's aide Emil Pain, looking back at political results of this year.
- The so-called red belt is buckled around Moscow after regional elections.
- Despite some apparent reorganisation in the Russian Defence Ministry, military reform has not yet started, and it is not clear when it will commence.
